features.role: Mapped footprint at the northwest corner of Capitol and Washington Streets, including the measured notches of the former U-shaped hotel structure.

identityStatus: The mapped outline at the National Register address and exact original public-domain Qualla photograph establish the building and exterior proportions.

terrainContact.basis: Original sidewalk elevation at the Capitol Street end near the corner with Washington Street.

notes: The historic record describes a ten-story blond brick mass, with an ornamented two-story mezzanine base, brick shaft with regularly spaced sash windows and a parapet with terra-cotta balustrade. The early-1980s conversion enclosed the back of the U-shaped plan.
